objective: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.

description: The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?
There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
completion: Well now... Where did you find this?
